tools_list.name: list_alignments
tools_list.description: List all alignments in the active Civil 3D drawing. Returns name, description, style, length, starting station and ending station for each alignment.

tools_list.name: get_alignment_info
tools_list.description: Return detailed geometry for a named Civil 3D alignment: length, start/end stations and a breakdown of every entity (tangent, circular curve, spiral) with type, station range, length and radius where applicable.

tools_list.name: get_station_offset
tools_list.description: Given a world coordinate (easting, northing), compute the station and perpendicular offset relative to a named alignment. Useful for checking whether a point is on or near a road centreline.

tools_list.name: list_profiles
tools_list.description: List all vertical profiles (AeccDbVAlignment) attached to a named Civil 3D alignment. Returns name, description, style, length, start/end stations and min/max elevations for each profile.

tools_list.name: get_profile_info
tools_list.description: Return detailed geometry for a named vertical profile on a Civil 3D alignment: start/end stations, min/max elevations, full entity breakdown (tangent grades, sag/crest curves) with station range, elevations, radius and K-value, plus a complete PVI list with station, elevation and curve length.

tools_list.name: create_cogo_point
tools_list.description: Create a new COGO (Coordinate Geometry) point in the active Civil 3D drawing. Provide northing, easting, optional elevation and description. Returns the assigned point number and coordinates.

tools_list.name: list_cogo_points
tools_list.description: List COGO points in the active Civil 3D drawing. Returns point number, northing, easting, elevation and description for up to max_count points.

tools_list.name: delete_cogo_point
tools_list.description: Delete a COGO point from the active drawing by its point number. Returns success confirmation or an error if the point is not found.

tools_list.name: get_corridor_info
tools_list.description: Return detailed information for a named Civil 3D corridor: description, style, baselines (with their alignment and profile names), regions per baseline, and the list of assemblies applied to each region.

tools_list.name: get_drawing_info
tools_list.description: Retrieve metadata about the currently active Civil 3D drawing: file name, full path, save state, unit settings, precision and coordinate system code.

tools_list.name: list_civil_object_types
tools_list.description: List and count Civil 3D objects in the active drawing. Returns two sections: model_space_counts (AutoCAD entity counts by object name) and civil3d_collections (named collection counts for surfaces, alignments, COGO points, corridors, pipe networks, etc.).

tools_list.name: get_selected_objects_info
tools_list.description: Return properties of the currently selected Civil 3D objects (handle, layer, object type, name/description where available). Use max_count to limit results.

tools_list.name: create_line
tools_list.description: Create a 3D line segment in the active Civil 3D drawing model space. Provide start and end coordinates in (X/easting, Y/northing, Z/elevation). Returns the object handle, layer and computed length.

tools_list.name: create_polyline
tools_list.description: Create a 3D polyline in the active Civil 3D drawing model space from an ordered list of vertices. Each vertex is [x, y, z]. Optionally close the polyline. Returns handle, vertex count and length.

tools_list.name: list_lines
tools_list.description: List lines and polylines in the active Civil 3D drawing model space. Optionally filter by layer name. Returns object type, handle, layer and length for each entity found.

tools_list.name: list_surfaces
tools_list.description: List all TIN and Grid surfaces in the active Civil 3D drawing. Returns name, description, style and elevation statistics (min/max/mean) for each surface.

tools_list.name: get_surface_info
tools_list.description: Return detailed statistics for a named Civil 3D surface: elevation range, mean elevation, point count, triangle count, 2D and 3D area.

tools_list.name: sample_surface_elevation
tools_list.description: Sample the elevation of a named Civil 3D surface at a specific (easting, northing) coordinate. Returns the interpolated elevation at that point. Raises an error if the point lies outside the surface.

tools_list.name: list_surface_definition
tools_list.description: List all definition items (boundaries, breaklines, contours, DEM files, drawing objects, point files, point groups, survey points, survey figures) that make up a named Civil 3D surface.
